name: June Yoon
source: June is a freshman and Haley's roommate. She's totally obsessed with video games to the point that she even brought her whole gaming setup to the Academy. Before starting the 1 course, she was super into streaming games and had a ton of followers. Socializing in person isn't her strong suit, but she had her own squad that she still hangs out with whenever she's got free time.
